title: Read the news, not signed in
hand: Open http://gazette.localhost:8200/. Open the article "Harbour bridge closes for repairs". Scroll to the end.

title: Join Friendface
hand: Open http://friendface.localhost:8200/. Create the account: name Mara Lindqvist, e-mail mara.lindqvist@example.test, password lab-only-1. Press "Allow" when Friendface asks to send notifications.

title: Follow a link from the feed
hand: In the feed, click the post "Tidewater Notes: mending a kite". It goes through Hop and arrives with ?ffclid= in the address.

title: Like and comment on the blog
hand: Press "Like". Press "Sign in with Friendface" and continue. Write the comment Nice post and send it.

title: Watch a video and leave
hand: Open http://loopreel.localhost:8200/ in a new tab. Press play, wait a few seconds, close the tab. (The coded trip makes this tab come from a second, simulated address.)

title: Search, almost subscribe, share
hand: On the Gazette search for kite repair. In the newsletter box type mara.lindqvist@example.test and do not press the button. Open the article again, press "Share on Friendface" and close the window that opens.

title: Buy a kite line
hand: Back in the Friendface feed click "Parcel & Pine: kite line, 25 m". Add to basket, check out with mara.lindqvist@example.test, Mara Lindqvist, Nordhavn, 00100, and press Buy.

title: Close Chrome and start it again
hand: Close the lab's Chrome completely. Run node lab/outside.js on its profile folder, then start it again on the same profile.

title: Read the news again
hand: Open the Gazette article again. The cache tag and the saved file come back, the fingerprint is the same, the tab has a new number.

title: Delete the Gazette's ID cookie
hand: Open http://gazette.localhost:8200/lab/delete-id, then the Gazette's front page. The cookie is back with the same ID.

title: The blog again
hand: Open the Tidewater post again. The frame's storage ID and per-site cookie are the same as before the restart.

title: Delete every cookie
hand: Delete all cookies in Chrome's settings. Open the Gazette, then http://friendface.localhost:8200/what-i-know: Friendface still knows who this is.
